title: YNX Monitor — Operational status and incident evidence
metaDescription: Review approved YNX operational status, incidents and recovery evidence without exposing private operator data.
h1: Operational evidence with strict authority boundaries
features: Typed backup, restore and rollback evidence
Fail-closed stale, tamper and replay handling
Source-bound local SBOM and reproducible build evidence
risks: Monitor presents owner facts but does not define chain finality, prices, solvency or release execution.
The public-status projection is locally tested and has no approved hosted publisher feed.
Local SBOM and provenance evidence is unsigned and no hosted DAST, public operator deployment, or production artifact is claimed.
The locked dependency graph discloses an npm registry mirror that still requires central Security/SRE acceptance.

faq.question: Does Monitor health mean every YNX service is healthy?
faq.answer: No. Monitor process health and each owner-provided service status are separate facts.

faq.question: Can Monitor execute a rollback?
faq.answer: No. Monitor records proposals and independent verification but does not execute infrastructure changes.
